comply-in.span: The system prompt acts as a persistent instruction set for the model.
Change behavior by editing the prompt, not retraining the model.
Enforces a uniform voice and style across all generated content.
Prompt variations can be tested in minutes, not days.

p: A system prompt is a set of instructions or context provided at the beginning of an LLM conversation that defines the model's behavior, tone, constraints, and capabilities. It acts as a persistent directive that shapes every response, ensuring consistency, alignment with user goals, and safety guardrails without requiring model retraining.

sec-head.p: The five-step process of defining, embedding, and executing a system prompt in an LLM interaction.

card.p: Craft the instruction set specifying persona, tone, and rules.
The prompt is prepended to the user's message in the API call.
The LLM interprets the system prompt as a high-priority directive.
The model produces output adhering to the given constraints.
Check that the response follows the system prompt's rules and tone.
